messages:
tim: Heads up — deploybot auto-softlocked a runtime pin for quant models earlier. seeing canary regressions, need coordination. @deploybot what exactly triggered the lock?

deploybot: auto-softlock triggered: kernel-quant-oom-rate > 0.05 on canary group c-quant-a100-eu-west between 03:12-03:18 UTC. pinned runtime to 3.3 for selector model:q-llama. command used: `deploybot pin runtime 3.3 --selector=model:q-llama --reason=\"quant OOM spike\" --expires=2026-04-25T08:00Z`

maria: Canary metrics: latency +45% and OOM spikes for longseq >2048. seems tied to the new int8 kv-reorder kernel path in 3.4.

jen: Quick question — do SDK2.x clients break if we keep 3.3 pinned? any handshake mismatch risk?

paul: SDK2.x should be fine with 3.3. Issue arises when 3.4 enables kv-reorder for quant; that path has subtle memory layout differences. need runtime-sdk log diff.

nisha: Ops telemetry: 12 customers hit errors, 3 with 500s. alert fired. I'm grepping the logs now for stack traces.

tim: Proposed plan: 1) keep softlock/pin 3.3 2) halt further promotions 3) hotfix runtime 3.4 to disable kv-reorder for quant 4) targeted canary for 6h 5) unpin if stable, else rollback.

leo: Agreed. Who owns hotfix? @eng-runtime?

maria: I'll own it. patch will disable reorder for quant path. ETA ~2h for branch + CI.

paul: Prepare an escape hatch rollback command to 3.2 in case hotfix regresses. also prep a short customer-facing note.

deploybot: escape hatch command template:
```
deploybot rollback runtime --from=3.3 --to=3.2 --selector=model:q-llama --reason='hotfix regression' --force
```

nisha: Runbook checklist: check /observability/latency/canary/q-llama and /errors/oom/quant. post screenshots and notable spans in this thread after canary spin-up.

maria: Patch branch: tmp/disable-kv-reorder-quant. CI green locally. canary rollout script:
```
./scripts/canary_rollout.sh --runtime=3.4-hotfix --models=q-llama --region=eu-west --duration=6h
```

jen: I'll ping Support + AMs about the potential impact for SDK2 customers and prepare a blurb for status page.

tim: @release-czar can we approve extending the pin expiry by 24h if needed? may need more room for testing.

release-czar: Approved. file a release-note entry under incidents and mark as `softlock: runtime-pin`.

maria: :thumbsup: starting canary deploy in 5m, will post telemetry.

nisha: Canary started at 1800000100 UTC. initial smoke: first 20 requests show latency back to baseline.

paul: Rule: if error rate >1% in any 15m window then abort and rollback.

maria: 20m in — still good, no OOMs observed. continuing monitoring.

tim: If hotfix holds for 6h we unpin during daytime window and run post-unpin smoke tests. set deploybot pin expiry to 2026-04-25T20:00Z tentatively.

deploybot: pin expiry updated to 2026-04-25T20:00Z by tim.

jen: Drafted support note & mitigations (reduce max_tokens for longseq; use batching). doc link: https://redwood.internal/docs/incidents/1799999999

maria: Hotfix promoted to staged after canary hold. running extended 2h smoke tests.

nisha: Alert: one customer reported a 500 at 1800000300 — investigating stack trace, looks like a client retry cornercase, not kv-reorder.

tim: Keep this thread as the source of truth. if hotfix fails, use the rollback template above and notify customers. if stable, follow the unpin checklist and close the pin. thanks all.
